answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the committed api-types.d.ts is stale. The generated output adds new GraphEdgeOutput values (IDENTITY_OF, WORKS_FOR, IN_TEAM, TEAM_OF, LINKED_TO, ATTACK_STEP) and new GraphNodeOutput values (PERSON, ORGANIZATION, TEAM). The change to GraphExplorationService.java added these without regenerating types. This is deterministic, so a rerun will fail the same way. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
